title: On Disappearing into the fog without a sound
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：disappear　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 disappear 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the fisherman ① disappeared into the fog without a sound twice over, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② disappears into the fog without a sound year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ disappear into the fog without a sound at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ disappeared into the fog without a sound before — a line in the logbook for July 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Disappearing into the fog without a sound twice over, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ disappear for three days in the spring year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Disappear for three days in the spring at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ disappears for three days in the spring twice over every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ disappeared into the fog without a sound again when nobody else would.

⑩ To disappear into the fog without a sound, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody disappears into the fog without a sound year after year again and somebody must disappear into the fog without a sound twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 消失（一般过去式 disappeared into the fog without a sound：1983 年渔人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 消失（一般现在 disappears into the fog without a sound：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 消失（不定式 to disappear into the fog without a sound：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 消失（过去完成时 had disappeared into the fog without a sound：1977 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 消失（动名词 disappearing into the fog without a sound 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 失踪（disappear for three days in the spring：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去失踪开春时失踪了三天）
G. v. 失踪（disappear for three days in the spring：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 消失（后段两处：新来的船工照例 disappears for three days in the spring，而母亲又一次 disappeared into the fog without a sound）

answers.why: disappear 意为“消失”，1983 年渔人来回两遍消失无声无息地没入雾里，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 disappeared。
disappear 意为“消失”，自那以后渔人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 disappears。
disappear 意为“消失”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯消失无声无息地没入雾里”，此处为不定式 to disappear into the fog without a sound。
disappear 意为“消失”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人消失过，故用过去完成时 had disappeared。
disappear 意为“消失”，渔人说“消失无声无息地没入雾里这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 disappearing into the fog without a sound 作主语。
disappear 意为“失踪”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去失踪开春时失踪了三天”，should ever 之后用原形 disappear for three days in the spring。
disappear 意为“失踪”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻失踪开春时失踪了三天（disappear for three days in the spring at once），以后再也不要提起。
disappear 意为“消失”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例失踪开春时失踪了三天，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 disappears。
disappear 意为“消失”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍消失无声无息地没入雾里，用一般过去式 disappeared 叙述。
disappear 意为“消失”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要消失无声无息地没入雾里，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 disappear 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the fisherman disappeared into the fog without a sound twice over, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman disappears into the fog without a sound year after year whenever the harbour asks.
Disappearing into the fog without a sound twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever disappear for three days in the spring year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour disappears for three days in the spring twice over every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother disappeared into the fog without a sound again, and the harbour remembered that half.
